legal_gdpr_transfer_mechanism: Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) + EU Frankfurt data residency pinning

legal_risks.risk: Zoho reseller channel creates privity gap — DPA and IP warranties may bind reseller, not Zoho Corp directly
legal_risks.mitigation: Require master services agreement and DPA to be executed directly with Zoho Corporation; reseller acts as billing agent only (aligns with procurement_risks finding)

legal_risks.risk: Subprocessor change notice (30 days) may be insufficient for Brightline's internal GDPR re-review cycle under Art. 28 GDPR
legal_risks.mitigation: Negotiate opt-out right without penalty upon material subprocessor change; add contractual obligation for Zoho to provide updated DPIA-relevant information within 10 business days of notice

legal_risks.risk: NetSuite third-party connector may involve a sub-processor not listed in Zoho's DPA, creating undisclosed cross-border transfer risk
legal_risks.mitigation: Map connector data flows before contract signing; require connector vendor to be added to Zoho DPA subprocessor schedule or execute separate processor agreement

legal_risks.risk: Liability cap in standard Zoho enterprise terms is typically capped at 12 months of fees paid — ~18 240 EUR for this deal — which may be inadequate for a data breach affecting EU personal data
legal_risks.mitigation: Negotiate enhanced cap (2x annual fees, ~36 480 EUR) for data breach events; ensure cap does not apply to wilful misconduct or GDPR fines indemnification

legal_risks.risk: Indemnification clause in Zoho standard terms excludes third-party IP infringement arising from customer data — Brightline's logistics data containing third-party schemas may trigger gap
legal_risks.mitigation: Obtain mutual IP indemnification covering customer data ingested into CRM; require Zoho to warrant no IP encumbrance in base platform

legal_risks.risk: Data export obligation on termination (30 days, TIFF/CSV per procurement_key_commitments) lacks enforceability clause and destruction certificate requirement
legal_risks.mitigation: Add contractual obligation for Zoho to issue a signed data destruction certificate within 60 days of export completion; include audit right for 12 months post-termination

legal_governing_law: Irish law recommended (Brightline EU-based; Zoho EU entity registered in Ireland)
